name: rtpengine
what_it_is: A high-performance RTP and UDP media proxy designed as a drop-in replacement for rtpproxy, primarily integrated with the Kamailio SIP proxy. Runs on GNU/Linux only and supports in-kernel packet forwarding for performance-critical deployments.
components: kernel module (xt_RTPENGINE) for in-kernel packet forwarding
measurement: Per-call statistics via ng control protocol
configuration: Configurable UDP port ranges for media
RTP profile selection (RTP/AVP, RTP/AVPF, RTP/SAVP, RTP/SAVPF)
Kernel module vs. userspace forwarding toggle
fault_injection: No dedicated fault injection interface documented
modes: Kernel-space forwarding mode (via xt_RTPENGINE kernel module)
Userspace forwarding mode (automatic fallback when kernel module unavailable)
constraints: GNU/Linux only — no macOS or Windows support
ZRTP encryption is not supported (packets pass through unmodified)
Kernel module required for maximum performance; without it falls back to userspace
Janus protocol support is limited, not full compatibility
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml found in repository (master branch returns 404)
No native Windows or macOS support
No built-in SIP signaling handling (requires external SIP proxy like Kamailio)
